blast_radius: Probe only, no writes to the queue.

throughput.derivation: loops.daily_counts() over planner-canary.jsonl ts field; error rate = ok=false / total.
notes: Occasional burst-test days are left in the sample on purpose: the median is robust to outliers where a mean would not be.

verification.note: Graded on throughput, not liveness: a running loop with zero volume is DEGRADED.

what_it_does: Hourly planner canary probing router models; volume is probe records, error rate is records with ok=false.
why_it_matters: The canary is the estate's early warning on planner-model reachability; a silent canary means outages arrive unannounced.
